correctness.rationale: Geometric singularity is equivalent to a full-support kernel vector of a principal submatrix of B; complete support analysis gives exactly 32 smooth sextuples, and scalar normalization gives 16. Three projective types follow from coordinate permutations and the explicit invertible binomial substitution. The three elliptic involution quotients have rational point counts (2,4,4), (4,4,4), and (6,4,4); their cohomology decomposes H1 and gives the asserted complete Weil polynomials and ranks. Exact independent Groebner and finite-field computations reproduce all claimed counts.

value.rationale: The naturally fixed split Klein-four Ciani locus over the smallest odd characteristic undergoes a sharp arithmetic degeneration: only 16 scalar equation classes survive, exactly three Weil spectra remain, and ordinary Jacobians are impossible, with a provable p-rank ceiling one. This is a structural field-specific classification tied to elliptic quotient factors, not a routine parameter rename or arbitrary finite slice.
